text: No, this asset is not deforestation-free. While it had tree cover in 2000 (34.5 ha, or ~7.9% of the asset), the JRC 2020 reference data shows **0% forest cover** in 2020. This indicates complete deforestation occurred before 2020. The analysis used a 30% canopy threshold and corroborated findings across datasets, confirming the loss. No forest cover remains as of the latest observation (2025).
